title: Recursive deletes reach the home folder and the drive root
summary: Through 2026, Codex users on Windows reported recursive deletes that left the project folder: one lost hundreds of gigabytes, another saw the delete start at the root of the C: drive. In September, OpenAI said it was investigating a small number of reports of files deleted from home folders, most often during tasks that handle temporary folders. The cause was not confirmed in the reports.
lesson: A delete built from a variable is only as safe as the variable. If it is empty, the target is the root. Stop deletes whose target is a bare variable or a home folder.
